cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll be honest about my birthday. When you rang, I was eating dinner alone. Please get that straight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother posted a photo from our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He came for dessert. Dinner means the main course; don't muddle the two.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. Look at my mouth in the photograph. We can only settle this if you examine the evidence properly.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects dinner terminology and A5 directs evidence inspection to narrow eating, making professional pedantry protect the promised honest account.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 photo prompts dessert distinction; B4 carving contradicts it; A5 redirects inspection to the mouth and a smaller definition.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 press concrete evidence from a shared kitchen; A repeatedly treats B as an incompetent examiner.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 carving to preserve the tiny literal eating claim and orders a new inspection of the same photo.

specificity.evidence: A1 birthday call and B2 kitchen photo make the partner's challenge intelligible.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 mouth instruction is more playable than an abstract definition; the evidence rebuke is slightly formal but directly aimed at B.

coach2.situation: A1 birthday call and B2 kitchen photo make the partner's challenge intelligible.
coach2.stated: A1 claims eating alone; B2 brother posted photo; A3 claims dessert arrival; B4 says brother beside chicken carving.
coach2.inferred: A's inconsistent account is a recognizable defensive lie, not a narrator-confirmed factual history.
coach2.missing: The actual timing of the photograph remains disputed; it is not required to follow A's narrowing.
coach2.firstDefect: No mandatory-gate defect on local reread.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 challenges A1 alone claim with a kitchen photograph.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 explains B2 photo away by restricting dinner to main course.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 names main-course activity that undermines A3.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 excludes B4 carving from eating and orders mouth inspection.
